about: Every change to the owner's copy of sanskritdocuments.org's text, by item (its ref in the copy): [the copy's words, ours, why]. The copy's words must occur exactly once in the item (make_text.py checks). reconciliation.md lists them with the witness.

1.104: the closing bīja, which the copy prints as a line of its own after the adhyāya (। ऐं ॐ ।), written at the end of the last mantra as Gita Press prints it (॥ ऐंॐ॥ १०४॥)
3.4: छित्त्वा, the absolutive of छिद्, with the doubled च्छ after the short vowel (Gita Press: तस्यच्छित्त्वा); छित्वा is a slip
3.5: समुच्छ्रित (उत् + श्रि, "raised high"); समुच्छृत is not a word (Gita Press: समुच्छ्रितम्)
4.9: a word-final m before a vowel is joined to it (त्वमभ्यस्यसे, Gita Press's), written across the line with a hyphen as the copy itself does in 4.10 (निधान- / मुद्गीथ…)
4.19: a missing space: साध्वी is a word of its own (the mind is kind, साध्वी, even towards the hostile)
4.27: न after र in the same word is ण (अस्त्राणि; Gita Press agrees)
4.42: the closing bīja, which the copy prints after the adhyāya (। ह्रीं ॐ ।), at the end of the last mantra as Gita Press prints it
8.53: a missing space: प्राह ("said") and सत्वरम् ("quickly") are two words
8.55: क्षीण ("drained"): with his blood drained the demon will perish; क्षेण is not a word (Gita Press: क्षीणरक्तो)
9.15: आविध्य, the absolutive of आ + व्यध् ("whirling" the mace); आविद्य is a slip (Gita Press: आविध्याथ)
a space inside the sandhi: देव्याः + त्रिशूलेन is देव्यास्त्रिशूलेन
9.23: तैः ("by those" cries); वैः is not a word (Gita Press: तैः)
10.16: a space inside the word अभ्यधावत ("rushed at")
12.10: a word-final m before a vowel is joined to it
13.15: a missing space: ददामि ("I give") ते ("to you")
kavacha.47: च ("and"); श्व is a slip (Gita Press: तत्रार्थलाभश्च)
chapter-2/dhyānam-1: परशुम्, an accusative like every other weapon she holds (दधतीं); परशू is a slip (Gita Press: परशुं)
chapter-7/dhyānam-1: accusatives, the objects of ध्यायेयं (Gita Press: मातङ्गीं), and शङ्ख, the conch-shell cup; शङ्क is a slip
chapter-12/dhyānam-1: विलसत् + हस्त is विलसद्धस्त (the copy drops the द्), and करवाल is written with ल as everywhere else in the text (Gita Press: करवालखेटविलसद्धस्ताभि)
